Parathyroid Disorder 
Calcium and loop diuretics balance sodium levels (Ellison, 2019). Loop diuretics inhibit the 
sodium–potassium–chloride transporter and increase calcium excretion. Furosemide increases calcium excretion 
and plasma parathyroid hormone (PTH). This hormone is created in the four small parathyroid glands located near 
the thyroid. It regulates the homeostasis of calcium, vitamin D, and phosphate in the bloodstream, maintaining bone 
stability (Khan et al., 2022). PTH responds to low calcium levels detected in the blood and stimulates the production 
of vitamin D and calcitriol. The increase in calcium excretion from loop diuretics leads to the parathyroid gland
